  (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f],
  topologicalKrullDim ↥X ≤ 1 →
    ∀ {V : X.Opens},
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen V →
        ∀ [IsIntegrallyClosed ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V))] {x : ↥X}, x ∈ V → x ∈ Singularity.regularLocus X

Singularity.Curves.ringKrullDim_sections.type:
∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme),
  topologicalKrullDim ↥X ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (U : X.Opens), AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U → ringKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) ≤ 1

Singularity.Curves.sectionAlgebra.type:
{k : Type u} →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) →
      (X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) → (U : X.Opens) → Algebra k ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))

Singularity.IsResolution.dense.type: ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {π : Y ⟶ X}, Singularity.IsResolution π → Dense (⇑π ⁻¹' Singularity.regularLocus X)

Singularity.IsResolution.isIso_over.type:
∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {π : Y ⟶ X},
  Singularity.IsResolution π → ∃ U, ↑U = Singularity.regularLocus X ∧ CategoryTheory.IsIso (π ∣_ U)

Singularity.IsResolution.proper.type: ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {π : Y ⟶ X}, Singularity.IsResolution π → AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper π

Singularity.IsResolution.regular.type: ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {π : Y ⟶ X}, Singularity.IsResolution π → Singularity.IsRegularScheme Y

Singularity.IsVariety.type: {k : Type u} → [inst : Field k] → (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) → (X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) → Prop

Singularity.IsVariety.finiteType.type:
∀ {k : Type u} {inst : Field k} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k}
  [self : Singularity.IsVariety X f], AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f

Singularity.IsVariety.quasiCompact.type:
∀ {k : Type u} {inst : Field k} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k}
  [self : Singularity.IsVariety X f], AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact f

Singularity.IsVariety.reduced.type:
∀ {k : Type u} {inst : Field k} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [self : Singularity.IsVariety X f], AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X

Singularity.IsVariety.separated.type:
∀ {k : Type u} {inst : Field k} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k}
  [self : Singularity.IsVariety X f], AlgebraicGeometry.IsSeparated f

Singularity.P1Hypersurface.type: (k : Type u) → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

Singularity.P1Ring.type: (k : Type u) → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k → Type u

Singularity.Reduction.compactSpace_sigma.type: ∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [Finite σ] [∀ (i : σ), CompactSpace ↥(Y i)], CompactSpace ↥(∐ Y)

Singularity.Reduction.eq_of_sigma\u03b9_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {i j : σ} (x : ↥(Y i)) (y : ↥(Y j)),
  (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i) x = (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y j) y → i = j

Singularity.Reduction.exists_range_subse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (K : Type u) [inst : Field K] (a : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧K ⟶ ∐ Y),
  ∃ i, Set.range ⇑a ⊆ Set.range ⇑(CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i)

Singularity.Reduction.exists_sigma\u03b9.type: ∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (y : ↥(∐ Y)), ∃ i x, (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i) x = y

Singularity.Reduction.isClosed_range_sig.type: ∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (i : σ), IsClosed (Set.range ⇑(CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i))

Singularity.Reduction.isIso_restrict_iSu.type:
∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u_1} (V : ι → Y.Opens),
  (∀ (i : ι), CategoryTheory.IsIso (f ∣_ V i)) → CategoryTheory.IsIso (f ∣_ ⨆ i, V i)

Singularity.Reduction.isIso_restrict_of_.type:
∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) {U V : Y.Opens},
  V ≤ U → ∀ [CategoryTheory.IsIso (f ∣_ U)], CategoryTheory.IsIso (f ∣_ V)

Singularity.Reduction.isIso_stalkMap_of_.type:
∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) [CategoryTheory.IsIso (f ∣_ U)] (x : ↥X),
  f x ∈ U → CategoryTheory.IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkMap f x)

Singularity.Reduction.isNoetherian_of_is.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [Singularity.IsVariety X f], AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian X

Singularity.Reduction.isProper_sigmaDesc.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (g : (i : σ) → Y i ⟶ X) [Finite σ]
  [∀ (i : σ), AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper (g i)] [QuasiSeparatedSpace ↥(∐ Y)],
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc g)

Singularity.Reduction.nonempty_irreducib.type:
∀ {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [inst : AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian X] {Z : Set ↥X},
  Z ∈ irreducibleComponents ↥X → ∃ x ∈ Z, x ∈ X.irreducibleComponentOpen Z

Singularity.Reduction.quasiCompact_sigma.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (g : (i : σ) → Y i ⟶ X) [Finite σ]
  [∀ (i : σ), AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact (g i)], AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc g)

Singularity.Reduction.range_subset_of_pr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [PreconnectedSpace ↥T] (a : T ⟶ ∐ Y)
  (i : σ) (t : ↥T),
  a t ∈ Set.range ⇑(CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i) → Set.range ⇑a ⊆ Set.range ⇑(CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i)

Singularity.Reduction.sigmaDesc_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (g : (i : σ) → Y i ⟶ X) (i : σ)
  (x : ↥(Y i)), (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc g) ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i) x) = (g i) x

Singularity.Reduction.sigma\u03b9_eq_sig.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {i j : σ} (x : ↥(Y i)) (y : ↥(Y j)),
  (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y i) x = (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι Y j) y ↔ ⟨i, x⟩ = ⟨j, y⟩

Singularity.Reduction.valuativeCriterion.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : σ → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (g : (i : σ) → Y i ⟶ X),
  (∀ (i : σ), AlgebraicGeometry.ValuativeCriterion (g i)) →
    AlgebraicGeometry.ValuativeCriterion (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc g)

Singularity.integralResolutionInDim_of_r.type: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, Singularity.ResolutionInDim p n → Singularity.IntegralResolutionInDim p n

Singularity.isRegularLocalRing_of_isInte.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R],
  ringKrullDim R ≤ 1 → IsRegularLocalRing R

Singularity.isRegularScheme_of_isIntegra.type:
∀ {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X],
  topologicalKrullDim ↥X ≤ 1 →
    (∀ (x : ↥X), IsDomain ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) →
      (∀ (x : ↥X), IsIntegrallyClosed ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) → Singularity.IsRegularScheme X

Singularity.isVariety_p1Hypersurface.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k),
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) →
    Singularity.IsVariety (Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) (Singularity.p1Structure k p n g)

Singularity.p1Structure.type:
(k : Type u) →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (p n : ℕ) → (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) → Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k

Singularity.p1_equation_ne_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), MvPolynomial.X none ^ p + (MvPolynomial.rename some) g ≠ 0

Singularity.purelyInseparableHypersurfac.type: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ResolutionInDim p n → Singularity.PurelyInseparableHypersurfaceResolution p n

Singularity.regularLocus_eq_univ_iff.type: ∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme), Singularity.regularLocus X = Set.univ ↔ Singularity.IsRegularScheme X

Singularity.ringKrullDim_p1Ring_le.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), ringKrullDim (Singularity.P1Ring k p n g) ≤ ↑n

Singularity.topologicalKrullDim_p1Hypers.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), topologicalKrullDim ↥(Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) ≤ ↑n
